# California Water Service Completes Water Infrastructure Upgrade in Willows


November 24, 2026 12:20 pm EST[Download as PDF](https://www.calwatergroup.com/_assets/_68b7494d3a1735c8c3e06fd8f5feeffb/calwatergroup/news/2026-11-24_California_Water_Service_Completes_Water_837.pdf)


WILLOWS, Calif.— California Water Service (Cal Water) has completed a water infrastructure improvement project in Willows that will help enhance water supply reliability and fire protection for customers in the area.


The project included the installation of approximately 2,550 feet of new 8-inch and 6-inch water main along portions of Fourth and Garden streets. The new main has been tested, connected to the water system, and placed into service.


Work was completed on:


- Fourth Street, between Cherry Street and East County Road 49½.
- Garden Street, between Third and Fifth streets.


"Investing in our infrastructure is essential to providing safe, clean, and reliable water service for our customers," said Tavis Beynon, Cal Water's Willows District Manager. "This completed project strengthens our water system, improves reliability, and enhances fire protection capabilities for the community for decades to come."


Following installation, crews flushed the new main, conducted water quality testing, and completed all necessary service connections before placing the pipe into operation. The upgrade is part of Cal Water's ongoing commitment to maintaining and improving critical water infrastructure throughout the Willows community.


**About California Water Service**


California Water Service provides high-quality, reliable water utility services to more than 7,200 people through 2,400 service connections in Willows and more than 2 million people through 500,000 service connections statewide. Cal Water’s purpose is to enhance the quality of life for customers and communities. To do so, it invests responsibly in water and wastewater infrastructure, sustainability initiatives, and community well-being. The company’s 1,200 employees live by a set of strong core values and share a commitment to protecting the planet, caring for people, and operating with the utmost integrity. The utility, commemorating a century of service this year, has been named one of “America’s Most Responsible Companies” and one of the “World’s Most Trustworthy Companies” by *Newsweek* , a USA Top Workplace, and a Great Place to Work®. More information is available at[www.calwater.com](https://www.calwater.com/) .
